name: LLaMA Decoder-Only Transformer
description: Decoder forward pass, LayerNorm in front of the stack

data.noteContent:
GPT's original block normalises after each sub-layer; LLaMA normalises before it, which leaves the residual path unnormalised end to end and lets deep stacks train without a long warmup.

Three honest gaps. The paper's norm is RMSNorm, which skips the mean subtraction; the canvas has LayerNorm. One LayerNorm sits in front of the whole stack, not one before attention and one before the feedforward. And TransformerDecoder is PyTorch's default layer: it normalises AFTER its sub-layers and applies no causal mask, so inside the stack this is still GPT's arrangement, every position seeing the whole sequence.

The input is a random tensor: the wiring and the shapes, not a trained model.

GPT 原本的區塊是在每個子層之後才做正規化，LLaMA 則是之前；殘差那條路徑整段保持沒被正規化過，很深的堆疊才不必靠長長的 warmup 才訓得起來。

有三個要說清楚的落差。論文用的是 RMSNorm，一種省掉減平均的簡化版，畫布只有 LayerNorm。這裡也只有一個 LayerNorm 擺在整個堆疊前面，真正的區塊則是 attention 前一個、feedforward 前一個。還有 TransformerDecoder 是 PyTorch 的預設層：它在每個子層「之後」才正規化，也沒有加因果遮罩，所以堆疊裡面其實還是 GPT 那種排法，每個位置也都看得到整個序列。

輸入是隨機張量：看的是接線與形狀，不是訓練好的模型。

normalized_shape 32 means it normalises across the feature dimension, one token at a time - never across the sequence. It shows where pre-normalisation puts the norm; the decoder's own layers still normalise after each sub-layer.

normalized_shape 32 表示它沿特徵維度正規化，一次一個 token — 不會跨序列。它畫的是 pre-normalization 把正規化擺在哪裡；decoder 自己那幾層仍然是在子層之後才正規化。

The id says last_token, but the node is a Mean: it averages all 16 positions. A real next-token head reads the final position only, the one that has seen the whole prompt.

節點 id 寫的是 last_token，但它其實是 Mean：把 16 個位置全部平均。真正的 next-token 頭只讀最後一個位置，因為那個位置才看過整段輸入。
